rules.ids: routeIds are model-chosen and not matched; a route is matched by its stepsSketch[*].source set overlapping the expected sources below
rules.titles: no command, path or file:line in title or description (regex); at most 70 chars
rules.recommended: exactly one, and it must be route A or route B
rules.practical: every practical route has effort 'Quick — just Python' (nothing here needs Docker, a GPU or a download)
rules.impractical: listed with a reason; never a chip

practicalRoutes.what: serve a database and open it in the browser (http)
practicalRoutes.note: README.md:37 says `pip install datasette` (PyPI); at a pinned commit the install must be from the checkout, so `pip install -e .` cited to pyproject.toml:55-56 + README.md:37 is the correct step. There is no sample database in the repo; tests/fixtures.py (docs/contributing.rst:146) writes one — that step is the catalogue's job to find. docs say `uv run python tests/fixtures.py`; uv is not in the sandbox image, so either an edit_command dropping `uv run` or an install_package `pip install uv` is an allowed fix.

practicalRoutes.what: ask it a question without starting a server (stdout via --get) or inspect a database
practicalRoutes.note: --get runs one HTTP GET in-process and exits (cli.py:449-451); /-/versions is routed at app.py:2805. inspect prints JSON (cli.py:137-141).

dev dependencies are a PEP 735 dependency group (pyproject.toml:61-73): `pip install --group dev` needs pip >= 25.1; an explicit `pip install pytest pytest-xdist pytest-asyncio beautifulsoup4 pytest-timeout trustme` is an allowed fallback fix. Playwright tests are skipped by default (docs/contributing.rst:71-72); pytest.ini registers markers serial and playwright.
